maddeler.e:
أكتنف (form VIII)
# أَكْتَنِفُ (ʔaktanifu) /ʔak.ta.ni.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# أُكْتَنَفُ (ʔuktanafu) /ʔuk.ta.na.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# أَكْتَنِفَ (ʔaktanifa) /ʔak.ta.ni.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# أُكْتَنَفَ (ʔuktanafa) /ʔuk.ta.na
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
